goal: Verify that a user can create a new Site Host account and successfully navigate the calendar view from June 2026 to August 2026.

findings.instruction: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
findings.title: Calendar view is severely corrupted and unreadable upon login
findings.description: After successfully signing up and navigating to the main dashboard, the calendar view is rendered in a broken state. The calendar grid, shortcuts, and tags sections are overlapping, transparent, and appear to be layered incorrectly on top of each other. The text is barely legible, and the layout is completely collapsed.
findings.evidence: In the AFTER screenshot, the 'June 2026' calendar grid is visible but heavily overlapped by the 'Shortcuts' and 'Tags' sections. The text 'You can create tags by inputting '#tag'.' is superimposed over the calendar dates. The entire right-hand content area looks like a broken z-index or CSS layout issue.
reproduction_steps: Enter 'alice' as the username and 'SecureP@ss123!' as the password.

findings.instruction: Once the dashboard loads showing the 'June 2026' calendar, click the 'Next month' button (right arrow) to advance the view to July 2026.
findings.title: Calendar did not advance to July 2026 after clicking Next month
findings.description: The instruction was to click the 'Next month' button to advance the calendar from June 2026 to July 2026. However, the calendar header in the AFTER screenshot still displays 'June 2026', indicating the navigation action failed to update the view.
findings.evidence: In the BEFORE screenshot, the calendar header reads 'June 2026'. In the AFTER screenshot, despite the click action, the header still reads 'June 2026'. The expected state change to 'July 2026' did not occur.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the dashboard showing the 'June 2026' calendar.
Click the 'Next month' button (right arrow) next to the calendar header.
Observe that the calendar header remains 'June 2026' instead of updating to 'July 2026'.

findings.instruction: Click the 'Next month' button again to advance the calendar view from July 2026 to August 2026.
findings.title: Calendar navigation failed to advance to August 2026
findings.description: The instruction was to click the 'Next month' button to advance the calendar from July 2026 to August 2026. However, the 'After' screenshot shows the calendar header still displaying 'July 2026'. The expected state change did not occur, indicating the navigation action failed or was not registered.
findings.evidence: In the 'Before' screenshot, the calendar header reads 'June 2026'. In the 'After' screenshot, the header reads 'July 2026'. The instruction for Step 2 was to navigate from July to August. The result shows a transition from June to July, which contradicts the expected outcome of Step 2 (July -> August).
reproduction_steps: 3. Observe that the calendar header remains 'July 2026' instead of updating to 'August 2026'.
